decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal

1.	The convertion of the existing dwellinghouse into two one-bedroom flats is not considered appropriate, as the existing dwelling is not of a size suitable for conversion, nor is a family sized unit retained.  It would result in the loss of a small house that is suitable for single-family occupation and is therefore contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

2.	The proposal to convert the existing dwellinghouse into two one-bedroom flats does not provide a private amenity space of a suitable size as per the requirements of Supplementary Planning Guidance, to the detriment of the amenity of both the prospective occupiers of the units and those that surround it.  The proposal would therefore be contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

3.	The proposal to convert the existing dwellinghouse into two one-bedroom flats due to a lack of independent access does not provide sufficient on-site car parking, which due to the heavily parked nature of St George's Road would be likely lead to increased congestion, which would be detrimental to the free and safe flow of traffic, which is contrary with policies H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Conversion of existing dwellinghouse into 2 X 1 bed flats incorporating removal of existing door to side and creation of two windows and door to rear elevation.
